Very beautiful place but the food is not at all worth the price!
Aug 2026 • Couples
We have now been in Vietnam for 15 days, and have been able to try many restaurants, including some ranked by Michelin.
The place is indeed very beautiful, but as for the food, it is really very limited, even mediocre! Indeed, no flavor!!! The flower and banana salad, served with shrimp chips, was very average; the appetizer, also served in banana leaves, a city specialty, was really bland; and my squid was way overcooked, too tough, and served with plain white rice.
At 2 million dong for a meal for two, the quality was really not up to par!!!
Good cooking isn't about making shapes out of carrots!!!
On the other hand, the staff was charming and very attentive! Maybe a good hotel?! But a more than average restaurant!!!!!
